notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
- Fixed zombies being able to walk down stairs.
- Fixed iron sights being slightly off.

notes.title: Fixed room generation
notes.content: Room generation has been fixed, and there will now be more rooms per level.

notes.title: Added the Forest level and optimised FPS.
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added the Forest level.
[*] Optimised FPS.
[*] Fixed many bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: SwapOut Forest Expansion/Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Announcing the first expansion to SwapOut. 

Enter the Killing Grounds, a new forest level to take place after No Mans's Land and the Labs.

More new content is on the way.

notes.title: Optimisation, AI Fix.
notes.content:
Enemies will know attack more consistently.

Enemies will no longer hover during the city levels.

General optimisation.

notes.title: FPS Fix and bullet registration fix
notes.content:
This patch should fix the FPS issues and also help with the bullet registration.

Doors also open quicker after the zombies have been cleared from an area.

Thanks.

notes.title: Drops are larger
notes.content: Almost all drops are roughly double in size for better visibility.

notes.title: Sensitivity and boss spawns
notes.content: Fixed Sensitivity bug and fixed boss zombie spawns.
